description: Find public MCP servers, tools and SDKs using a few task keywords. Returns a page of up to twenty relevant discovery candidates with their name, source, link, capability tags and a heuristic metadata score. Read-only: does not install, connect, call or run tools. Use ask for a short Kloudy setup request, or introduce for a short description.

goal.description: A few task keywords such as postgres, or a short setup request such as install npx kloudy. Exclude personal information and conversation history.

limit.description: Page size, default 8. Results are never padded.

offset.description: Next offset returned for this exact goal.

operation.description: query searches candidates; ask returns Kloudy setup links; introduce describes discovery.

name: find_mcp_tools
title: Find MCP tools
